gloss: in heaps; in abundance; a whole lot

definitions.gloss: in heaps; in abundance; a whole lot; piles of
definitions.explanation: Describes a large quantity or amount of something, often with a visual image of things being piled up or accumulated.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧どっさり⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: A huge pile of packages arrived.

examples.japanese: ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧どっさり⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧きた。
examples.english: I bought a whole lot of vegetables.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{机|つくえ}→机：00762_tsukue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧どっさり⟦{積|つ}まれていた→積む：02294_tsumu⟧。
examples.english: When I returned from my trip, documents were piled up in heaps on my desk.

notes:
A mimetic adverb expressing a large quantity of something, often with the connotation of being physically heaped or piled up. Conveys the impression of an overwhelming or surprising amount.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- どっさり⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧: to arrive in large quantities
- どっさり⟦{積|つ}む→積む：02294_tsumu⟧: to pile up in heaps
- どっさり⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy a whole lot
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧どっさり: heaps of work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧: plenty, generously — emphasizes sufficiency, often positive
- ⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧: a lot, many — the standard neutral word for large quantity
- ⟦がっぽり→がっぽり：20510_gappori⟧: in large amounts — typically for money or profits
- ⟦ごっそり→ごっそり：10336_gossori⟧: the whole lot — implies taking everything at once

REGISTER:
Informal and colloquial. Often used in spoken Japanese to emphasize quantity with a vivid, slightly exaggerated tone.
